Actually we can call it four times: Lakers 2018, Lakers 2020, Bulls 2018, Bulls 2020. But maybe we can combine? The function signature expects team and season. So we need to call it separately for each pair.

Usually we would do separate messages for each call. But the guidelines also say: "If you need to make multiple calls, you can do so in sequence." So we will send one function call at a time. After receiving result, we can decide next call. But we might not get results yet. The system may respond with the result. Then we can proceed.

Thus we first call calculate_winning_percentage for Lakers 2018. Then wait for result. Then call for Lakers 2020. Then Bulls 2018, then Bulls 2020. Or we could ask for all four at once but function only accepts one team-season pair. So we need sequential calls.

We'll start with Lakers 2018.
